q4.token_method: RS256 JWT minted in process by pyjwt.encode with the PEM read from Secrets Manager secret 'opal/auth/jwt-private-key' (sitting_r28 KEY_SECRET). Claims: sub = the address, iss 'opal-portal-auth', aud 'opal-portal-api', firmId 'opal-capital', tier 'internal', role 'user', userType 'test-filer', name, iat, exp = iat + 1140. The sitting names no key slot: it signs with the current private key, and the authorizer verifies against current and previous slots (getJwtKeySlots, verifyWithSlots). Token held in memory only, never printed or written.
